acceptedAnswer.text: It is the work of bringing in enquiries from people likely to buy, then passing your sales or admissions team the ones worth a conversation. The measure that matters is the cost of a qualified lead, not the number of form fills.

mainEntity.name: How do CRM and Meta CAPI improve lead quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: A form fill only tells Meta that someone showed interest. When your leads sit in a CRM, we send what happened next (qualified, meeting booked, applied, won, enrolled) back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI). Meta can then learn which leads your team actually wants and look for more of them, instead of optimising for the cheapest form fill.

mainEntity.name: What counts as a qualified lead?

acceptedAnswer.text: That is for your sales or admissions team to define, and we agree it with them at the start. It might be a lead that answers the phone and fits your criteria, a booked meeting, or a completed application.

leaks.h2a: Five mistakes that fill the funnel with
leaks.lede: Most lead generation is measured on volume. Each stage below is where quality is lost, and the part of our service that protects it.

stages.breaks: Marketing counts every form fill as a lead.
stages.why: If marketing and sales never agree what a good lead is, campaigns get judged on volume, sales complains about quality, and nobody can tell which is right.
stages.does: We start by agreeing with your sales or admissions team what a qualified lead is, and the stages a lead passes through. That definition drives targeting, tracking and reporting.

stages.breaks: Broad targeting, so the ads reach anyone who might click.
stages.why: Cheap clicks from the wrong audience become expensive leads that never buy or enrol. Intent matters more than reach.
stages.does: We aim search and paid social at the queries and audiences that signal a real need, and build the SEO that keeps you found between campaigns.

stages.breaks: A long form on a slow page, with no clear next step.
stages.why: Many enquiries start on a phone. Every extra field and every second of load time loses a lead who was already interested.
stages.does: We build fast, mobile-first landing pages and short forms with one clear next step, such as a call, a demo or a WhatsApp message, and test them.

stages.k: Qualify with CRM and Meta CAPI
stages.why: Ad platforms learn from what you tell them. Told only that a form was filled, Meta finds whoever fills forms cheapest, and lead quality can fall as volume rises.
stages.does: We connect your leads to a CRM and send the stages that matter (qualified, meeting booked, applied, won, enrolled) back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI), so campaigns learn what a good lead looks like.

stages.breaks: Leads wait days for a reply, then go cold.
stages.why: Many leads are not ready at first contact. The business that replies quickly and keeps sensible contact is the one remembered when the decision is made.
stages.does: We build retention funnels of WhatsApp, email and call reminders, triggered from the CRM, that keep each lead warm until they are ready and win back the quiet ones.
